milestones.title: Correct input binary
milestones.summary: The Xbox 360 executable is verified, decrypted from the player's own disc and surveyed for recompilation.

milestones.title: Toolchain + recompile-only PoC
milestones.summary: All 72,864 functions translate to C++ with zero recompiler errors, warnings or unrecognized instructions; 242 instruction tests pass.

milestones.title: Native compilation and link
milestones.summary: The translated code compiles and links into a native arm64 app, with every import defined and no unresolved symbols.

milestones.title: Runtime initialization
milestones.summary: The runtime boots the game through kernel, file system and GPU bring-up to its first frame swap, in 10 of 10 consecutive launches.

milestones.title: First frame (rendering)
milestones.summary: The EA logos and the movies render through MoltenVK on Metal, with no unknown texture formats or dropped draws.

milestones.title: Audio, movies, input
milestones.summary: Music, movies, keyboard and controller menus pass. The physical controller was tested by hand on an 8BitDo Ultimate 2 Wireless, and movies are paced evenly since v0.1.1.

criteria.title: Front-end music plays 5 minutes with no underruns
The intro movie plays at the correct speed
Default keyboard and controller mappings pinned by unit tests
Keyboard rebinding in Settings > Controls works and persists
Menus with a physical controller and with the keyboard, by hand
Smoother movie frame pacing (frames off the even cadence from 18.5% to 1.7%)

milestones.title: First boot to free-roam / race load
milestones.summary: Accepted for the alpha: a new profile saves and reloads after a restart, a race loads, and free-roam held 15 minutes. The new-profile route ran on a fresh macOS account without free-roam in the same session, which the 15-minute test covers.

criteria.title: A new profile is created, saved, and reloads intact after a restart
A race or free-roam loads from the front end to control of the car
No deadlock or crash in 10 minutes of free-roam
The new-profile route: a new profile, a race load and a restart, with logs and the save recorded (free-roam covered by the 15-minute test)

milestones.title: Playable racing
milestones.summary: Accepted for the alpha: every criterion met under the alpha criteria. The physical controller has since been tested by hand. Still open, none recorded as passed: Xbox 360 physics equivalence, audio sync, which rests on the tester's report, and Reverse on the keyboard by hand.

criteria.title: AI opponents spawn, race and finish
A full career race finishes and its progress survives a restart
Steering, throttle, brake, handbrake, nitrous and camera on the keyboard, by hand
Playable driving physics in a full race (equivalence with the Xbox 360 version not verified)
A stable 30 fps or better on a MacBook Air M5 over a full race (9.8 minutes, accepted)
Audio in sync and no world geometry missing, as reported by the tester
The written test route, repeated 3 times

milestones.title: Polish and distribution
milestones.summary: Completed for the alpha: v0.1.0, the first playable alpha, is released (2026-10-26). A release candidate passes every automated check and was installed and played by hand on a MacBook Air M5, including a clean install on a fresh macOS account. Render scaling and widescreen followed in v0.1.4 (Internal Resolution and Expanded View), and a physical controller was tested by hand. Not verified: controller rebinding on a physical controller, Game Mode on a fresh account, and an install on a MacBook Air M1.

criteria.title: Keyboard presets: WASD (the default) and Arrows
Separate keyboard and controller profiles that persist
Custom mappings, controller rebinding, switching and reset to default
Existing key bindings migrated into a profile, never dropped
Reset to default matches the M5 baseline
The unit tests run in ctest
The app bundle check (check_app.py) passes
Both presets drive the game by hand (Arrows on the tester's report); custom profiles survive a restart and switching applies at once, in scripted runs
A clean install from a disc image on a fresh macOS account
The installer parametrized for Carbon
The app packaged and released with its notices and third-party source archive
Optional: render scaling and widescreen (Internal Resolution and Expanded View, v0.1.4)

features.title: Recompiled to native code
features.text: 72,864 functions from the Xbox 360 executable, translated with 0 recompiler errors and structural validation passing.

features.title: Boots and renders
features.text: The game boots to its own screens; the EA logos and the movies render through MoltenVK on Metal.

features.title: Front-end music
features.text: Over 5 minutes with no underruns or gaps, in 3 of 3 runs.

features.title: Keyboard menus, audio and lip-sync
features.text: Keyboard navigation, rebinding that survives a restart, audio quality and movie lip-sync, checked by a person (hand test 2).

features.title: Career saves
features.text: A new career save (286,764 B) is written and reloads after a restart with its hash unchanged.

features.title: 15 minutes of free-roam
features.text: Free-roam after the prologue chase, 15 minutes in a row with no crash or hang (hand test 3).

features.title: A career race, won
features.text: Zone Heat 1 finished in 1st place against AI opponents; the cash and progress were still there after a restart (hand test 4).

features.title: Keyboard and controller profiles
features.text: WASD and Arrows presets, custom profiles, controller button rebinding and migration of existing bindings, in scripted runs and unit tests.

features.title: Playable racing on the keyboard
features.text: Quick Races driven by hand on the WASD keys, on a MacBook Air M5 and an M1: steering, throttle, brake, camera, Handbrake (Space), Speedbreaker (Left Shift) and, on a car that has it, Nitrous (Backspace). On the M5, 1st place over 8 laps against 7 AI opponents who all finished.

features.title: Physical controller
features.text: An 8BitDo Ultimate 2 Wireless in menus and races: every current button and mapping is correct, and View + Menu together open Settings.

features.title: Game actions on a virtual controller
features.text: In a Quick Race: RB changes the camera, LB looks back, the right stick shifts gears, the Left Trigger reverses and Start pauses.

features.title: 48 unit tests
features.text: Every ctest entry passes on a MacBook Air M5 and an M1 Mac.

issues.title: Occasional stalls of about 1 s
issues.text: The presenter waits for a free drawable while holding the GPU queue lock. Why no drawable is free isn't known yet.

issues.title: GPU-idle stalls of 250–600 ms
issues.text: No lock wait is involved. The cause is unknown.

issues.title: Frame rate falls in long races on a MacBook Air M1
issues.text: Races start at about 30 fps and fall with time under load, to 16–22 fps in 9- to 15-minute races. GPU throttling on the fanless M1 is a hypothesis, not a confirmed cause. The MacBook Air M5 held about 51 fps with no fall.

issues.title: Texture cache grows during play
issues.text: Textures are kept until a setting reloads them, so long sessions use more memory: about 500 MB over 7 laps. On current evidence it doesn't cause the M1 frame-rate drop. An experimental eviction is in v0.1.1, off by default until a realistic budget is tested.

issues.title: Hitches in the first race after a fresh install
issues.text: With an empty shader cache the first race compiles its pipelines as it goes: the worst frame was 450 ms on a fresh macOS account (MacBook Air M5), and 100 ms in the next session.

humanTests.title: The new-profile route
humanTests.covers: A new profile, a race load and the save found after a restart, run as the fresh-account install (M6.6, MacBook Air M5). Free-roam wasn't in that route; the 15-minute free-roam test covers it.

humanTests.title: The Arrows preset by hand
humanTests.covers: The tester played the game on the Arrows preset and reports that it worked (M8.11, 2026-10-26). No log was kept of that session. WASD drove every hand-tested race.

humanTests.title: Profile switching and a restart, by hand
humanTests.covers: Switching profiles without a restart, and a custom profile across a restart (M8.11). Verified in scripted runs and unit tests only.

humanTests.title: Hand test 5: the remaining keys
humanTests.covers: Reverse on the keyboard. Look Back, Change Camera, Pause and the gear shifts on O / L were tried by hand on 2026-11-03; Handbrake, Nitrous, Speedbreaker, the camera and the gear shifts on K / ; on 2026-10-25.

humanTests.title: Sessions 3–5: the M7 route, 3 times
humanTests.covers: Controls, physics, frame times, audio and picture over full races: three on a MacBook Air M1 and two on an M5 (M7.1, M7.2, M7.5–M7.7). Audio sync rests on the tester's report.

humanTests.title: Clean install on a fresh macOS account
humanTests.covers: Installing from a disc image on a new user account, a new profile, a race, and the save found after a relaunch (M8.4, MacBook Air M5). Game Mode wasn't captured on that account.

humanTests.title: Release candidate on a MacBook Air M5
humanTests.covers: Install from a disc image, Game Mode, a race to the results, the save kept after a relaunch, a clean quit (the main account).

humanTests.title: Release candidate on a MacBook Air M1
humanTests.covers: The same checks on the M1. Not run: testing for the alpha ended first.

humanTests.title: Physical controller
humanTests.covers: Menus and driving on an 8BitDo Ultimate 2 Wireless: every current button and mapping correct, View + Menu open Settings (2026-10-31), and a play-test of the v0.1.5 release candidate with it (2026-11-07). Rebinding on the pad was checked with a virtual controller only.

achievements.text: ReCarbon v0.1.5: HDR, off by default, gives brighter highlights on an HDR display, with macOS HDR or HDR10, ported from SpeedBreaker: Carbon v0.1.1. With HDR off it runs level with v0.1.4. Experimental switches stay off.

ReCarbon v0.1.4: Expanded View, on by default, shows more of the game world on a screen that isn't 16:9, such as a MacBook's 16:10, with Off for the original 16:9 view; the settings are named in plain words; a 4K render cap and an Export Performance Report. Experimental switches stay off.

ReCarbon v0.1.3, a performance and stability update: the game's waits for the GPU no longer spin a CPU core, so races on a MacBook Air M5 use less than half the CPU on the main thread and the Mac throttles later; vertex data up to 128 KB is copied with its draw, removing a stall; the Frame Rate setting explains each choice. Thermal judder at 2x on a fanless Mac remains a known limitation.

M6 and M8 closed for the alpha: the new-profile route (a new profile, a race and the save found after a restart, on a fresh macOS account) and the alpha packaging, with v0.1.0 released. Not verified: a physical controller, Game Mode on a fresh account, an install on a MacBook Air M1.
ReCarbon v0.1.0, the first playable alpha, is released for Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 27: a disk image to install with your own Xbox 360 disc image. Known limitations are on the Known issues page.

Alpha packaging validated on a MacBook Air M5: two release candidates pass every automated check, and one was installed from a disc image and played by hand, in the main account and on a fresh macOS account, with its save found after a relaunch.
ReCarbon has its own app icon, drawn from this website's mark, on the app and on the opened disk image.

Playable racing accepted for the alpha: full Quick Races driven by hand on the keyboard, on a MacBook Air M5 (50.8 fps on average over 9.8 minutes of racing) and an M1. Still open: the physical controller and Xbox 360 physics equivalence. No alpha build is published yet.

Fewer long stalls when other apps keep the Mac busy: the game threads that drive each frame now run at a higher macOS priority. On a MacBook Air M1 under load, stalls of 100 ms or more went from 5.3 to 0.3 per race run, at the same frame rate.
This Progress page: milestone states checked against the roadmap, verified features, known gameplay issues, pending hand tests and recent work.
